answers.genPolicy:a7f5336bedbc2e391061c8bac3423d:
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (Members) , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'invite' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ...) , ... > .
[B1] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... >
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , 'device' : deviceB , ...) , UserY : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > .
[B2] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , deviceB : ('key' : K , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'requestKey' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , deviceB : ('key' : K , ...) , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (deviceB ; K) .
[B2] < UserX | 'key' : nils , ... > $ cloudA 'sendKey' UserX | (deviceB ; K)
=> < UserX | 'key' : K , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | 'key' : K , 'power' : false , ... > $ UserX 'turnOn' deviceB | (K)
=> < deviceB | 'key' : K , 'power' : true , ... > .
[B4] < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'power' : false , ... > $ UserX 'cloudTurnOn' cloudA | (deviceB)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('device' : deviceB , ...) , ... > < deviceB | 'power' : true , ... > .
[B5] < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : (UserY) , ...) , UserY : ('device' : D , ...) , ... > $ UserX 'removeMember' cloudA | (UserY)
=> < cloudA | UserX : ('members' : nils , ...) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ... > if D =/= nils .
